propositions: Documentation ownership policy must distinguish eight categories: durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, protected evidence, ticket events, and ADR decisions without enforcing deterministic character, word, punctuation, or prose validators.

Writing rules and Protected forms guidance must be restored to docs/documentation-policy.md as approved authoring guidance that explicitly does not define a deterministic validator or repository gate.
Generated artifact catalog and contributor tables must be losslessly relocated to docs/generated-artifacts.md with all catalog rows, regeneration commands, and enforcement gate references preserved.

Policy pointer guidance in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must reference documentation ownership, correction paths, and writing guidance without describing rules as deterministic gates.
Ticket corrections must remain append-only events; ADR corrections must preserve decision substance through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs without erasing original substance.
